basis: Only sources the repository already records in reports/SCOPE-COUNTS-2016-2026-20261015.json source_cards. No network fetch, no invented URL.

rule.identity_supported: A reusable legal source attests that this paper existed in this year with this subject/variant.
rule.identity_unverified: No year-specific source; or the repository's own card explicitly says the identity is not settled.
rule.answers_blocked: No reusable legal source in this repository gives an answer key. Official URLs appear inside answer blocks only 6 times, all as content citations in explanations, never as keys.
rule.generic_only: Answer provenance states the kind of key, not which source.

global_finding.what_they_are: Content citations inside explanations (人民日报 PDF, gov.cn policy page, xinhuanet science page). None is an answer key.
global_finding.conclusion: For every sampled paper the answer-source gap is answers_blocked, not merely unsourced. No official answer-key source exists for 行测 anywhere in the repository.
